column1: # Line printed by commit-title.sh, tab, tree state, tab, expected status line. Both status-line twins
# must agree on every line. Blank lines and # lines are skipped. A - field stands for empty.
# A title written for the current working state shows as is
# A title written for an earlier working state is marked
# A stale title on a clean tree was most likely for work already committed, so it shows nothing
# Only the leading state word is read, never one inside the title
